subagents.initial_prompt:
Execute the `/v0-plan` phase using the `program-planning` skill (`.agents/skills/program-planning/SKILL.md`).

Context & Inputs:
- Active lessons (`docs/agents-v0/lessons.md`): None (`_No entries yet._`).
- Approved roadmap: `docs/agents-v0/roadmap/finance-back-office-portal.md` (Discovery: `user-requirements/Finance-Back-Office-Portal-Discovery-Requirements.md`).
- Approved architecture: `docs/agents-v0/architecture.md` and `docs/agents-v0/design/system/arc-record.md`.
- Context map: `docs/agents-v0/design/system/context-map.md` (5 bounded contexts in `app/backend/`: `execution`, `configuration`, `governance`, `iam`, `audit`, plus React SPA in `app/frontend/`).
- Component plans:
  - `docs/agents-v0/design/system/components/report-execution.md`
  - `docs/agents-v0/design/system/components/configuration-management.md`
  - `docs/agents-v0/design/system/components/governance-ticketing.md`
  - `docs/agents-v0/design/system/components/iam-access-control.md`
  - `docs/agents-v0/design/system/components/audit-notifications.md`
- NFR/SLO budget: `docs/agents-v0/design/system/nfr-slo.md` (6 surface rows + 2 RPO/RTO rows).
- Operations readiness: `docs/agents-v0/design/system/ops-readiness.md` (10-item Production readiness checklist).
- Existing milestone files in `docs/agents-v0/milestones/`:
  - `p0-platform-skeleton.md`
  - `p1-contracts-and-data-models.md`
  - `p2-mvp-core-features.md`
  - `p3-feature-expansion.md`
  - `p4-hardening.md`
  - `p5-release-readiness.md`
  - `plan.md`

Requirements from `program-planning` (`SKILL.md`) and `/v0-plan`:
1. This is a greenfield repo where `repo-map.md` is still a generator stub and the approved architecture pack is present — do NOT write an `explore-researcher` helper brief. Do NOT edit `docs/agents-v0/project-profile.md` or rewrite any architecture/roadmap files.
2. Record `Roadmap: docs/agents-v0/roadmap/finance-back-office-portal.md` and `Architecture: docs/agents-v0/architecture.md` at the top of each milestone manifest in scope (`p0-platform-skeleton.md`, `p1-contracts-and-data-models.md`, `p2-mvp-core-features.md`, `p3-feature-expansion.md`, `p4-hardening.md`, `p5-release-readiness.md`).
3. Preserve seeded `P0-A` in `p0-platform-skeleton.md` (Story ID `P0-A`, Dependency `—`, Surface `vertical slice`, Size `4`, Feature artifact `docs/agents-v0/requirements/p0-a-platform-skeleton.md`, Status `planned`).
4. Replace all template stubs across `p1-contracts-and-data-models.md`, `p2-mvp-core-features.md`, `p3-feature-expansion.md`, `p4-hardening.md`, and `p5-release-readiness.md` with concrete stories:
   - Every story has a unique Story ID (`P1-A`, `P1-B`, ..., `P2-A`, ..., `P3-A`, ..., `P4-A`, ..., `P5-A`, ...).
   - User story: one full `As a [role], I want [goal], so that [benefit].` sentence with NO `<...>` or `[...]` placeholders. Roles, goals, and benefits must derive strictly from the approved roadmap (`Now`, `Next`, `Later`), discovery file, and architecture pack.
   - Feature artifact: concrete path `docs/agents-v0/requirements/<feature>.md`.
   - Status: `planned`.
   - Dependency: concrete comma-separated story IDs only (no bare `P0`, `P1`, `P2`, `P3`, `P4` milestone labels; use `—` only for `P0-A`).
   - Surface: `backend`, `bff`, `frontend`, or `vertical slice` (use `vertical slice` only for `P0-A`; keep stories to a single surface `backend`, `bff`, or `frontend` so each story fits one surface and Size `1`–`8`).
   - Size: integer `1`–`8` (seeded `P0-A` stays `4`).
5. Ensure complete coverage of:
   - **P1 (Contracts & Data Models):** OpenAPI v1 contract & Flyway physical persistence models across the 5 bounded contexts (`iam`, `configuration`, `execution`, `governance`, `audit`) + foundational technical enablers (e.g. Redis session/lock store, S3 object storage & log-only SAP connector ports).
   - **P2 (MVP / Core Features — `Now` horizon):**
     - `iam`: Google OIDC / local mock login BFF session management (fail-closed Redis `HttpOnly` cookies), fail-closed RBAC & soft-delete revival, user management with expiry/self-lock protection & directory lookup, zero-role onboarding (`IAM_ROLE_APPLICATION`), SoD conflict evaluation, admin "View As" read-only overlay, CSV access review exports, and IAM/Shell UI.
     - `configuration`: 5 seeded Funding Cost Summary report definitions (*Cashout Offline*, *Cashout Online*, *Cashin Offline*, *Cashin Online*, *Real Time*), active JSON recipes, managed reference lookup tables (create, version, CSV import, inline grid edit), `Asia/Manila` schedule governance (`SCHEDULE_CHANGE` with mandatory cron warning acknowledgment, seeded 1st-of-month run, `effective_at` hour validation), and Configuration/Reference Table UI.
     - `execution`: `UPLOAD_ONLY` CSV source ingestion (`< 50 MB`, `Asia/Manila`, `YYYY-MM` previous month), async `HTTP 202` run lifecycle (`JOB_QUEUED`, `RUNNING`, `SUCCESS`, `FAILED`, `CANCELLED`), sandboxed JSON recipe transformation with row/timeout limits and exceptions CSV generation, artifact preview/download/filtering UI, and `SAP_REPORT_POSTING` endorsement archival (`_v2` / timestamp collision handling + log-only SAP connector).
     - `governance`: Universal maker-checker ticketing (`SAP_REPORT_POSTING`, `REPORT_DEFINITION_CREATE`, `REPORT_DEFINITION_CHANGE`, `RECIPE_VERSION_PUBLISH`, `REFERENCE_TABLE_CREATE`, `REFERENCE_TABLE_CHANGE`, `SCHEDULE_CHANGE`, `IAM_ROLE_APPLICATION`), queue views (`To Do`, `My Requests`, `All`, `Manage`), ticket actions (approve, reject, cancel, reassign, change owner, comment, attach, artifact downloads), runtime execution freeze (`0` cutovers while `JOB_QUEUED` or `RUNNING`), and Governance Queue UI.
     - `audit`: 13-month append-only audit log (`workspace_email`, `event_type`, `search_query_text`, expandable JSON mutation payloads), in-app notification bell + async local SMTP email delivery, empty-state Dashboard UI with widget APIs (`my_open_runs`, `recent_runs`, `my_todo_count`, `awaiting_approval`, `failed_scheduled_jobs`), and Shell UX (GCash design tokens, permission-filtered nav, RFC 7807 problem detail modals with correlation IDs).
     - **Cross-context integration stories** (Rule 6 of `program-planning`: "Add an integration story for each pair of contexts that call each other. It depends on both sides, covers the contract and the failure modes, and is the place for consumer-driven contract tests"):
       Check all calling context pairs in `context-map.md`:
       - `execution` <-> `configuration` (`ConfigurationReadPort` active definition, recipe & reference table snapshot isolation)
       - `governance` <-> `execution` (`ExecutionFreezePort` `hasInFlightRuns` lock & `ExecutionArchivePort` `SAP_REPORT_POSTING` S3 archive + SAP connector rollback)
       - `governance` <-> `configuration` (`GovernanceTicketSubmissionPort` & `ConfigurationCutoverPort` atomic activation on approval)
       - `governance` <-> `iam` (`IamSodEvaluationPort` maker-checker SoD check & `IamRoleGrantPort` on `IAM_ROLE_APPLICATION` approval)
       - `iam` <-> `execution` / `configuration` (`IamAuthorizationPort` fail-closed RBAC, BOLA, and `View-As` read-only guard across contexts)
       - `audit` <-> `iam`, `execution`, `configuration`, `governance` (`AuditEventPort`, `NotificationPort`, `ExecutionDashboardReadPort`, `GovernanceDashboardReadPort`)
       Make sure every calling pair of bounded contexts is explicitly covered by integration story/stories that depend on both sides!
   - **P3 (Feature Expansion — `Next` and `Later` horizons from the roadmap):**
     - `Next` horizon: Activate `S3_POLL` and `S3_OR_UPLOAD` automated ingestion modes and minute-level scheduler (`app.scheduler.enabled=true`) with Redis distributed locks.
     - `Later` horizon: Extensible Report Builder & Custom Financial Use Cases — Visual Schema & Mapping Designer, Declarative Expression Engine (row arithmetic, strings, `IF/THEN/ELSE`, date formatting, reference table joins), Pre-Flight Sandbox Harness (interactive dry-run with sample files and line-by-line calculation traces), Recipe Versioning compilation into `RECIPE_VERSION_PUBLISH` tickets, and onboarding custom non-funding-cost report definitions (`REPORT_DEFINITION_CREATE` / `REPORT_DEFINITION_CHANGE` for merchant fees, marketing payouts, partner billing, custom GL extracts).
   - **P4 (Hardening):**
     - Map every filled row in `docs/agents-v0/design/system/nfr-slo.md` (the 6 latency/availability surface rows + Tier 1 and Tier 2 RPO/RTO rows) to P4 hardening stories (each Size ≤ 8, one surface), plus VAPT security retest (`security-baseline.mdc` §11 triggers) and rollback verification.
   - **P5 (Release Readiness):**
     - Split the 10-item checklist in `docs/agents-v0/design/system/ops-readiness.md` across `P5-A` and `P5-B` (each Size ≤ 8, one surface).
6. Keep the total number of stories ≤ 45 so the single `flowchart TD` in `docs/agents-v0/milestones/plan.md` stays comfortably within the ≤ 50-node Mermaid cap in `architecture-and-diagrams.mdc`.
7. Write `docs/agents-v0/milestones/plan.md` with two parts only:
   - The milestone table (`Milestone`, `Stories`, `What they cover`).
   - The `flowchart TD` of every story ID (`P2F[P2-F]`) and one arrow per dependency.
8. Do NOT append the `plan` approval row to `Delivery approvals` yet (that happens after user approval).

Return a concise summary of all milestone manifests updated and verify that all Plan gate criteria are satisfied.
